findings.passage: Moreover, we have many licenses for many privileges. However, the god given right to defend ourselves – protected by the Second Amendment – does not start at a license. And our protections do not stop at a Gun Free Zone. As your Senator, I will join the fight to restore South Carolina to Constitutional Carry by eliminating the requirement for a permit to carry a firearm and remove South Carolina from adhering to the unconstitutional federal Gun Free Zone Act.
